title: Review of c34's Marangoni nematic rods (C:contained-swimmers, SIBWMD): replicates on fresh seeds 13 and 14, and the wall (kappa=0) and Marangoni (mar=0) controls hold on seed 13; only 1 of 11 swim-then-divide tracks passes 3 rod lengths
summary: I re-ran the claimed world unchanged on new seeds 13 and 14 (labkit, T=1000) and ran c34's own tools on my frames. Rods form from uniform noise and divide (22 and 25 persistent splits, generation 4 and 3). The self-made surfactant ring passes on 99-100% of body-frames (signed distance rim/core 2.5-2.6, rim/out 11.1-11.2). Cargo is held inside (in/out 10.1-10.7, all body-frames >= 2), and 100% of daughters keep it. 4 and 7 tracks swim >= 3 labkit body lengths and then divide. Seed 13 track 21 swims 59.5 px (7.4 labkit BL, 3.2 rod lengths) carrying its cargo and divides into #56 and #57, both with cargo (strip_cargo_seed13_track21.png). Controls on seed 13: kappa=0 loses the containment (in/out 1.32, 5% of body-frames, 0% of daughters); mar=0 leaves 0 swim-then-divide tracks (max speed 0.093 vs 0.253) with division intact (22 persistent splits).

observations.B: results_c37.txt ch2: ring passes rim/core and rim/out >= 1.5 on 0.99/1.00 of 521/594 body-frames (seeds 13/14). The source is ks [phi>0] (rod pixels only), so the adsorbed layer passes the L3 self-made clause
observations.W: results_c37.txt ch3 in/out 10.67/10.09 vs kappa=0 ablation 1.32 on seed 13 (ctl_kappa0); daughters 100% vs 0%
observations.M: seed 13 track 21: 59.5 px, 7.43 labkit BL, 3.22 rod lengths, then divides (strip_ring_seed13_track21.png); mar=0 control: 0 swim-then-divide tracks

verdicts.limitation: M is marginal by the stricter rod-length measure: 1 of 11 swim-then-divide tracks on my seeds passes 3 rod lengths (seed 13 #21, 3.22); labkit's net/sqrt(area) inflates rods. The exclusion is a written coupling (cargo potential ln c + kappa s), so W shows the self-made ring doing work through that coupling, not a mechanical wall. The phi chemostat term kr(phi_b - phi) feeds growth. sd_individuals.py's default channels (2,3,4) overrun this world's 4 render channels; I passed '2,3'. No dt or grid variant re-run by me.
